images.name: light
images.prompt:
Ultra-wide 3:1 panoramic game background, 2000x667. Reference 1 castle is art style and palette reference: softly faceted painterly 3D stone, purple blue shadows, amber candles, red wooden doors, brass ornament and burgundy carpets. Reference 2 Kyoto veranda is exact composition and camera reference.
Reimagine castle as a broad vaulted observation gallery overlooking a deep grand hall, NOT a narrow tunnel. Seated eye-level viewer, horizon 48 percent up from bottom, cylindrical panoramic feel, no fisheye bulge. Vault ribs overhead and stone floor seams lead toward dead-centre distant focus, gentle wide curvature like Kyoto beams. Two thick gothic stone pillars left/right of centre frame a very broad central opening. Low carved stone balustrades along gallery edge with a wide central gap.
Distant focus: 10-15 metres away, small centred ornate gothic doorway to royal dispatch chamber, deep plum carved double doors slightly ajar with soft lavender light within, modest wax-sealed envelope emblem above doorway. Door opening just below horizon, distant and small like Kyoto garden gate. Quiet hazy far wall behind, clear broad central route.
Rich side furnishings: covered arcaded aisles left and right recede into depth. Tall pointed windows with lavender dusk sky, amber candle sconces, brass framed castle landscape paintings, carved wooden side desks with parchment stacks, quills and wax seals, bookcases and scroll cubbies, wooden chests, burgundy hanging banners with simple gold fleur-de-lis shapes, ornamental empty suits of armour at lateral midground. Varied coherent clusters, not mirrored duplicates. Side tables sit at extreme left/right and deeper beside columns. Busy detail at edges and midground, calm central field.
Foreground completely open worn violet-gray flagstones with subtle reflections and a burgundy runner leading toward distant door. NO table, desk, chest or props across near centre, no floating email, weapon, character or UI. Keep ceiling framing and floor proportions comparable to Kyoto. LIGHT haunted/dusk state: legible warm candlelight, soft lavender-blue window fill, slightly mysterious inviting fairytale castle, faint low mist only in distant hall. No text, writing, logo, vignette, ghosts or people. Single full-bleed panorama.

images.name: dark
images.prompt: Edit this exact castle gallery panorama into its DARK HAUNTED night version. Preserve identical camera, 3:1 framing, all architecture, paired pillars, vault ribs, railings, central distant doorway and its opening angle, banners, armour displays, desks, books, paintings, chests, windows and floor patterns. Change only lighting and atmosphere. Sky through windows deep indigo-purple night, much darker ambient fill, rich plum and blue-violet shadows. Candles dimmed to smaller warm amber pools. The thin opening of distant central doorway shines eerie lavender spectral light as focal point, casting subtle purple illumination on runner. Slightly denser low violet mist in far hall only, clear foreground. Cool moonlight softly outlines armour, stone arches and furnishings without making neon outlines. Haunted mysterious fairytale atmosphere, still readable game background. No ghosts, characters, eyes, monsters, added props, writing, logo or UI. No vignette. Keep all side furniture in same place and central approach clear. Same painterly softly faceted 3D art, 2000x667 panoramic.
